core_obligations: Since E is perfect, take its dual perfect complex E-dual (named input).
Identify R SheafHom(E, G-bullet) = E-dual tensor^L G-bullet by construction of the dual.
Apply the carded tensor-form lemma to E-dual and G-bullet; conclude K = Rf_* R SheafHom(E, G-bullet) is perfect.

difficulty_reason: A short reduction through perfect duality into the carded tensor form; complete and explicit.
